items.title: George "Kid Sheik" Colar Interview, 1959-01-20
items.q: I used to follow Cuckoo. He used to play them yard parties too.

ctx.x: Just a second. Okay, you and your violins, I don't see why you don't. Well, anyway...

Yeah, I had that old beat up cornet it was. I just remember who I got that cornet from. I just remember who I got that cornet from. One old trumpet player, yeah, the cornet. I just remember it in there. It's been a good while. Anyway, I was around about ten or eleven years old then. And I fooled around and I could never blow the thing. I used to put a kazut in it. I used a mouthpiece to put a kazut. The mouthpiece to put a kazut? No, I'd put the kazut in the, you know, where the mouthpiece goes. You see, in the…
They have a lot of guys that just play piano and guitar and all kind of odd instruments serenading like that.
